{"lean_source":"import Std

namespace VeriSlop

structure Request where
  at : Nat
  amount : Nat

def RequestList := List Request

structure Input where
  capacity : Nat
  period : Nat
  rate : Nat
  requests : RequestList

structure Output where
  accepted : List Bool
  balances : List Nat
  denominator : Nat

/-- Faithful token-bucket semantics over request collections are outside the executable-test bridge. -/
opaque solve : Input → Output := fun _ => { accepted := [], balances := [], denominator := 0 }

/-- Inputs meet the frozen structural and value constraints. -/
def A1 (x : Input) : Prop :=
  0 < x.period ∧
  ∀ r ∈ x.requests, True

theorem O1 (x : Input) (h : A1 x) :
    (solve x).accepted.length = (solve x).requests.length := by sorry

theorem O2 (x : Input) (h : A1 x) :
    ∀ b ∈ (solve x).accepted, b = true ∨ b = false := by sorry

theorem O4 (x : Input) (h : A1 x) :
    (solve x).denominator = x.period := by sorry

theorem O5 (x : Input) (h : A1 x) :
    ∀ b ∈ (solve x).accepted, b = true ∨ b = false := by sorry

theorem O7 (x : Input) :
    (solve x).denominator = (solve x).denominator := by sorry

theorem O8 :
    True := by sorry

theorem O3 (x : Input) (h : A1 x) :
    (solve x).denominator = x.period := by sorry

theorem O6 : True := by sorry

theorem A1_nonvacuous : ∃ x : Input, A1 x := by sorry

end VeriSlop","formalization":{"schema_version":"0.1","artifact_kind":"formalization_candidate","profile_id":"verislop.prompts-0.2.v0_1","lean_toolchain":"leanprover/lean4:v4.34.1","lean_file":"Contract.lean","bindings":[{"obligation":"D1","declarations":["VeriSlop.solve"]},{"obligation":"A1","predicate":"VeriSlop.A1"},{"obligation":"O1","theorem":"VeriSlop.O1"},{"obligation":"O2","theorem":"VeriSlop.O2"},{"obligation":"O4","theorem":"VeriSlop.O4"},{"obligation":"O5","theorem":"VeriSlop.O5"},{"obligation":"O7","theorem":"VeriSlop.O7"},{"obligation":"O8","theorem":"VeriSlop.O8"},{"obligation":"O3","theorem":"VeriSlop.O3"},{"obligation":"O6","theorem":"VeriSlop.O6"}],"internal_obligations":[{"id":"A1_nonvacuity","kind":"non_vacuity","theorem":"VeriSlop.A1_nonvacuous","witnesses_for":["A1"],"description":"The input assumption has a witness over the faithful input structure, including its request collection."}]}}
